message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data acquisition/preparation code; files are opened and parsed without validation of structure or content.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data files are read directly from local paths with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; no remote fetching with security controls is present.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code loads and tokenizes data without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained GloVe embeddings and model checkpoints (via `self.load()` and `build_embedding_matrix`) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The code initializes datasets and logs their sizes but never checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly analysis, or any other backdoor defense present in the training loop or model code.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard Adam (optim.Adam) with no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy integration anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing logic anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a separate test set is loaded, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement preventing test-set leakage into training, and only a single set of metrics is tracked (val_acc, val_f1) without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (forward method and dataset loading) performs no shape/range validation or schema checks on incoming inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The model's forward method returns raw logits/losses without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or calibrated threshold enforcement on outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM (it is a sentiment analysis model using GloVe embeddings), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
